reviews.t: Great alternative from battery operated products
reviews.x: This product is a beast. Scared the living daylights out of me when I was using the pick cleaner the first time. Water came put super strong so I shouldn't have even turned the faucet on all the way. The water pick literally flew out of my hand and went berserk in my bathroom. I digress, Faucet operated; batteries not necessary. Product itself can use a slight cosmetic makeover because the sticker makes it look cheap. Hung it on the wall adjacent to our faucet and the adhesive is holding up well

reviews.t: Great item wonderful price
reviews.x: Bought this for my 92+ year old dad, who was having trouble controlling a regular stand alone dental irrigator. Plus it was hard for him to fill the water reservoir all the time. This solves both problems & I'm even thinking of getting one for myself & as xmas gifts for the whole family. So easy to install.

reviews.t: Top-Notch Product.
reviews.x: This item was delivered today and I couldn't be happier.  I used to have one hooked up in the shower and it wasn't working quite right anymore, so I ordered one for the sink.  Was super easy to hook up and works great.  Used it on my teeth and gums and am totally satisfied with the performance.  You can adjust the pressure of the water jet by adjusting your faucet handle.  Turning the lever on the unit itself doesn't adjust the spray strength.  If you're looking for a great product, this is it.

reviews.t: These comments are rediculous. Almost everyone of them are ...
reviews.x: These comments are rediculous. Almost everyone of them are written by the same person using a different name. The product may or may not be valid but almost everyone of the comments are a bunch of bologna.

reviews.t: Clean feeling!
reviews.x: This is my first water pik purchase and I'm happy I got it! So worth the price, the water pik leaves my teeth feeling so clean and gets gunk out that flossing can't! It's great that you can adjust the water pressure to the pressure that feels right for you. A little pressure goes a long way. Love it! I haven't used the toothbrush yet but I will give it a try..

reviews.t: Will not work on a standard 3/4" sink fawcet
reviews.x: As supplied this item cannot be installed on a standard US 3/4" OD threaded sink faucet. To connect the Sagreho Water Flosser to a standard US faucet requires a 7/8" OD threaded to a 3/4" ID threaded reducer. I searched for this item locally and online without success. I consider this Water Flosser to be defective as received since it cannot be attached to my faucet, a Delta manufacture fawcet. This is to inform those considering purchase of this item that if their bath sink fawcets

reviews.t: One Star
reviews.x: Missing pieces still have not been able to use it.

reviews.x: this CANNOT be installed in the shower, there are no parts for that included and they are not available to purchase either.  also the plastic adapters included and needed for many faucets maybe too short and the plastic threads slip.

reviews.t: Jet is the perfect name for this pick!
reviews.x: I love this! The price was great and it is super easy to install. I didn't need to bother with the rack or the other heads. It comes with 3 identical water spout heads and 3 identical water spout brush heads. I assume this is so that more than 1 person can use the product without having to share heads. We have electric tooth brushes and I don't mind sharing the spout head with my husband, so we really only use 1 spout head.  I was unsure if this would work in my bathroom sink. However, it was ea

reviews.t: Not as good as the Water Pik since it doesn't have pulsating ...
reviews.x: It's okay. Not as good as the Water Pik since it doesn't have pulsating flow. The hose keeps splitting and blowing off. Each time it does I have to cut it off past the split and reattach it to the outlet. Eventually the hose will be to short to use.  The seller contacted me and issued a credit since I had trouble with it. For the price it is a good product and worth the money. It's not that big of a deal to replace the tubing. You can get replacement tubing at any local hardware store.

reviews.t: The best of the 3 types I've tried
reviews.x: I've now had 3 types of water picks and this is the best so far. The first was an actual water pik. Its power level was too high for me and it was inconvenient to use. It cluttered the sink, had a clunky coiled hose and needed ac power to run. I stopped using it after a few months even though my mouth felt clean. reviews.t: So far very happy with purchase
reviews.x: Decided to give this a try instead of spending $80.00 on a WaterPik.  I stumbled upon this while searching for a WaterPik to purchase.  This product arrived very quickly, with a few days from ordering.  Installation was super easy, although very little guidance provided by manufacturer.  This product works great so far without any leaks.  The control valve is solid metal and very well made.  When turning control from faucet to flosser there is no struggle.  The switch is adjustable so you can co

reviews.t: I'm returning, to complicated to assemble. No instructions ...
reviews.x: I'm returning, to complicated to assemble. No instructions no toothbrushes or where to purchase them. So you have this thing over your sink if you get it done, half empty anyway. 😕

reviews.t: Flosses well
reviews.x: Could be a little easier to connect to faucet.  Many newer faucets have thread mechanisms buried up in spout which makes it virtually impossible for this to accommodate regardless of all the little adapters this company furnishes with the product.  However, if you are fortunate enough to make it work it is great to work with and is always handy.  Noise is virtually cut down to what some running water sounds like.  Pressure is very adequate to floss teeth.  Company should address engineering solu

reviews.t: Does not fit recessed aerator faucets.
reviews.x: This Seller needs to tell prospective Buyers that this product DOES NOT FIT the newer designer faucets that have recessed aerators, which are the most popular faucets now days. These are not like simple the aerators on other faucets.  It's recessed and screws up inside the faucet tip. Standard aerators are just screwed on to the end of the faucet tip and can easily be removed by unscrewing them with a pair of pliers. My Delta faucet needs a special key/wrench to remove the aerator that you can p

reviews.t: Metal where it needs to be.
reviews.x: I rarely rate and review products when requested. This one was particularly good. this is my second connect to water faucet dental pick. The first unit I had for a year and a half. The entire unit was plastic and broken. This dental spa is metal where it needs to be. It also includes water brushes. Which allow you to pick during and after brushing without having to chance attachments. This is a really nice feature.  My only complaint is that perhaps the whole is slightly too small and with highe

reviews.x: I purchased this SMAGREHO oral irrigator in March 2018.  The water diverter is metal, as is one of the adaptors.  The rest of the adaptors are white plastic.  All of the adaptors have male threads on both sides.  The threads on the diverter are female, and the threads in your faucet which your old aerator screwed in to need to be female as well. reviews.t: This thing is like a pressure-washer for your mouth
reviews.x: This thing is like a pressure-washer for your mouth!  I have to run the sink at half strength. It really does a great job of cleaning your gums and between your teeth.  A good price, too;  and it should pay for itself in a couple years, since I won't have to buy bags of flossers anymore.  And it's way less of a hassle than other water-flossers, since it doesn't require electricity or a manually refilled resevoir.  UPDATE:  I recently moved, and this is not nearly as powerful at my new place as i

reviews.t: Very good.
reviews.x: I am an actual purchaser of this product and my review is genuine. The water pick is well made and works well.  I attached it to the bathroom sink by removing the aerator with a pair of pliers.  Then installed the water diverter by hand.  Attached the holder assembly to the wall with adhesive. It works flawlessly and no leaks.  The water pressure is good, but not as strong as the  electric motorized water picks I own.  But does a decent job of cleaning my mouth. I recommend this product. Happy w

reviews.t: buying two more for the other bathrooms.
reviews.x: Not the most powerful water pick out there I guess? Easy to install and does the job of getting in between your teeth and massaging your gums. Very easy to use just a flip of a switch. Make sure the pick is in your month because it dose squirt a good jet. We are buying two more for the other two bathrooms. 4.5 stars I guess only because I think a FEW people might want a stronger jet?

reviews.t: Does not fit standard sink faucets.
reviews.x: Updated to four stars because even though the product wasn't great the seller  refunded and had excellent customer service  None of the attachments fit standard sinks (my faucets are typical Lowe's/Home Depot) and are two different styles. Neither of them can be fitted to any of these attachments.

reviews.t: Worth every penny if it means my kids take care of their teeth!
reviews.x: My daughters really love this Oral irrigator. It attaches to the faucet and has an easy on/off switch. There are many attachments. My one daughter uses the toothbrush part and the other daughter mainly uses it as an irrigator. She says it is way easier and more fun to use than floss.

reviews.t: After using for less less than a couple days, ...
reviews.x: After using for less less than a couple days, hose burst and I could not use it.  I did find some refigerator hose forwater connection and decided to give it a try.  It fit very well but I have to tighten it about once a week.  Hose needs to stronger.

reviews.t: It works just fine. Happy I figured out how to install in ...
reviews.x: It works just fine.  Happy I figured out how to install in my shower, but you have to buy several parts and it may not have the final aesthetics that some would find ok.

claims.text: Many reviewers find it easy to install and a good value compared to battery-operated or pricier alternatives.
Several reviewers report faucet compatibility and adapter problems, including issues with standard US faucets and shower installation.
Some reviewers praise the cleaning performance and adjustable water pressure.
A few reviewers report weak spray, hose splitting, or missing pieces.
Some reviewers complain about complicated assembly, missing instructions, or suspect reviews.
